title: research: does wolfCrypt zero private key bits on wc_ecc_free / wc_FreeRsaKey
description: wp11_backend_soft.c frees soft key structs by calling wc_ecc_free() / wc_FreeRsaKey() / wc_ed25519_free() then free(key). If wolfCrypt does not internally zero the private scalar/exponent on key teardown, those bits remain in freed heap pages until the allocator reuses them -- a potential heap disclosure window. Research: inspect wolfCrypt source for wc_ecc_free and wc_FreeRsaKey to determine whether they zero private key material. If they do not, wp11_soft_key_free() must explicitly zero the relevant fields (key->ecc.k, key->rsa.d, etc.) before calling the wolfCrypt free functions. Check both the wolfCrypt version in ~/wolfssl and the minimum supported version.
